segments.summary: Reviewed ACD-109 through ACD-116 line by line for web owner bridging, capability/routing truth, native-reader identity, evidence provenance, Firecrawl transport and cost/fallback behavior, and provider-specific research semantics; identified missing fallback transactionality and offline rules.

Reviewed ACD-117 through ACD-123 for change tracking, denied metadata, output fields, activity cards, deferred dereference, batch limits, and permission scope, plus the terminal handoff family reaching ACD-131; identified attach-recovery race ambiguity.

Reviewed ACD-124 through ACD-131 for ownership cleanup, provider carry-through, terminal card anatomy, promotion/session ownership, action canon, recovery, collapsible behavior, and terminal ownership, then adversarially tested the adjacent terminal continuity/search contracts for streaming and scale gaps.

Reviewed ACD-132 through ACD-139 across terminal fidelity, PTY continuity, surface routing, workspace controllers, search, command-block confidence, restore states, and attention; carried the exact/adversarial lens into transcript, accessibility, diagnostics, and recovery postconditions.

Reviewed ACD-140 through ACD-147 for transcript/reset truth, labels/accessibility, diagnostics, command-card boundaries and degradation, reveal origin, linked surfaces, and runtime identity, then inspected the following child-card projection for lifecycle-label loss.

Reviewed ACD-148 through ACD-155 for closed runtime fields, mode mapping, child-run identity, parent visibility, projection boundaries, required cards, and collapsed/expanded anatomy; adversarially evaluated status propagation and transition races in the adjoining canonical lifecycle family.

Reviewed ACD-156 through ACD-163 for context disclosure, canonical statuses and signals, parallel ordering, grouped fan-out, parent mediation, user-input display, and Crew overlay semantics; identified an underspecified strict-stop execution boundary.

Reviewed ACD-164 through ACD-171 for attributable Crew boards, child-run alignment, Ask/Plan and Crew authority ceilings, provider resolution, shared question fields, ordering, revision, and dismissal; identified missing questionnaire validation, persistence, privacy, accessibility, localization, and resume rules.
